newsitem.title: UK: Man says world sugar market to stay in tight range.
newsitem.headline: Man says world sugar market to stay in tight range.

text.p: The world sugar market is set to stay in a tight trading range, according to trade house E D & F Man.

"Limited competition from the exporters and the prospect of tightening supplies next season are expected to support values around present levels despite very poor offtake," Man said in its latest monthly "Sugar Situation" report.
"Equally, the continued absence of any Chinese interest and only a muted response from the Russian buyers has provided a little upward pressure," it said.

"The initial outlook for 1997/98 production and consumption numbers is for a tighter balance, with India emerging as a potential importer, the EU crops not showing much improvement and crops in many of the remaining major producers showing little sign of substantial improvement potential," Man said.
